source.title: By The Light's Grace
source.description: Aeonas needs immediate healing or he will die. Call upon the light and save him.
source.completion:
<Aeonas seems to be breathing more easily now. He still seems quite weak, but he manages to turn his head towards you to speak.>

You say that Katherine sent you? Bless that woman. Thank you, <class>. I am in your debt.
